import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-87/tests/acceptance/W2-87")
import w2_87_support as s  # noqa: E402

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    api = s.Api(Path(tmp) / "api")
    t = time.time()
    root = s.build_project(Path(tmp) / "repo", s.CONFIGS["main"])
    api.build(root)
    print("build s", round(time.time() - t, 1))
    print("plain", [p for _, p in api.plain_order(root, s.PHRASE)])
    b = api.retrieve(root, s.PHRASE)
    print("labels", s.labels(b), b["stopping_reason"], b["merge"]["dropped"])
    print([(i["path"], i["start_line"], i["end_line"], i["routes"]) for i in b["evidence"]])
    b = api.retrieve(root, s.UNRELATED, ids=[s.CLOSED_OVER])
    print("closure", s.labels(b), [i["routes"] for i in b["evidence"]], b["gaps"][:3])
    b = api.retrieve(root, s.CUT_PHRASE, batch_size=2)
    print("cut", s.labels(b), [g["path"] for g in b["gaps"]])
    b = api.retrieve(root, s.PHRASE, favour=[s.FAVOURED], reranker=s.STUB)
    print("stub", s.labels(b))
    root2 = s.build_project(Path(tmp) / "repo2", s.CONFIGS["absent"], s.SUPERSEDED_LAST_REGISTER_TEXT)
    api.build(root2)
    b = api.retrieve(root2, s.PHRASE)
    print("r2", s.labels(b, s.SUPERSEDED_LAST_REGISTER_TEXT), b["merge"]["dropped"])
    r = api.command(root, "--batch-size", "3", s.PHRASE)
    print("cli", r.returncode, r.stdout[:200])

task: Write W2-87's acceptance tests (DAEO-s9qc) from its KPI lines before the implementation exists, show them red, and commit them in two parts.
status: DONE. Both commits exist, and every case the brief says must be red is red for the reason the README gives.
work_completed: Part 1 tests that a register chunk belongs to its own entry (3 tests). Part 2 tests the authority order read from the path map's `retrieval_authority` block (18 tests, counting parameters). A shared support module and a conftest plant temporary repositories built from nothing; the lexical index and store are built by `lexical.refresh` and `gov.store.load`, with no vectors and no `gov rebuild`. A README maps each KPI line to its tests and red reasons.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-87/README.md, tests/acceptance/W2-87/conftest.py, tests/acceptance/W2-87/w2_87_support.py, tests/acceptance/W2-87/test_w2_87_register.py, tests/acceptance/W2-87/test_w2_87_authority.py
evidence: Commit `57ff98b0bd30` is part 1 (register file, support, conftest, README part 1). Commit `bc95da4d7382` is part 2 (authority file, rest of the README). Both carry the trailers `Task: DAEO-s9qc`, `Role: independent-test-designer`, `Implements: DEC-952, CAP-10`.
tests: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-87/src python3 -m pytest tests/acceptance/W2-87 -q -p no:cacheprovider` gives 16 failed, 5 passed in 32.6 s. The same run with `-p no:randomly` gives 16 failed, 5 passed. `--collect-only` collects 21 tests cleanly.
discoveries: Lexical hits come back ordered by path and then line, so with the semantic route off the plain fused order is the path order. The tests check this through `lexical.search` and `rrf` before relying on it. The scores of neighbouring ranks differ by about 0.0002–0.0015, so a lift of 0.004 puts every governing chunk first, and test 2b's 0.00054 lift is sized to these exact ranks. A closure over `ids=["DEC-104"]` returns an empty bundle today.
risks: Test 2b hard-codes RRF with k = 60 and the lexical path order: governing +L, reports −L, margins about 0.00013. Its README row gives the arithmetic. The planted path map copies this repository's path map and removes any `retrieval_authority` block from it, so the engineer's real block on this branch cannot leak in. Five green guards (part 1's nothing-newly-dropped, 3b, 6a and both 6b) protect today's behaviour. They are not red by design.
lessons: Sandbox check: (a) refused with "Read-only file system"; (b) `hash-object` and `update-index --refresh` both worked. Role, ticket, toplevel and branch were as expected. I used `gov retrieve` once, for the acceptance-store question; it answered with generic W1-27 and W1-16 hits, so I read W1-21's support files directly. Read refusals met: 0. Write refusals met: 2. A Write under `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/work/` was denied, so I used the session scratchpad. A shell-variable write target was denied by the guard. A later literal-path `rm` asked for approval and I did not retry it. P-R1 results served: none.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: Two leftovers the denied cleanup could not remove: the scratchpad (8.0K, 2 inodes, holding `w2_87_probe.py`) and `tests/acceptance/W2-87/__pycache__` (80K, 5 inodes, git-ignored). pytest's own temp retention is left as it is.
